    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A region named "While you were away" with a heading that says how long; the rows are a list
      - listitem: "Every action says which task – \"Decide: Ingest pipeline\" – and each row says its state in words, never color alone"
      - listitem: Got it and the divider are buttons with aria-expanded; the folded part is inert, so Tab never lands in it
      - listitem: "When an item changes, a polite live region says so – \"Ingest pipeline: done. 1 needs you\""
      - listitem: "Focus never drops to the page: a working button stays focusable (aria-disabled, not disabled), and when a row loses its button or the card folds from outside, focus moves to the next action or the divider"
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The mark of what needs you breathes softly – the one thing that moves while you read
      - listitem: "A change swaps the row in place: the new mark pops in, a done tick draws itself, the count rolls up"
      - listitem: Folding and opening slide the height between the card and the divider
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything simply appears
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Rows keep one height in every state, so nothing below moves when something resolves
      - listitem: Narrow, the counts drop under the title and long titles and details end in … (the full text in a tooltip); on touch screens buttons are 36px tall
      - listitem: A long action label of your own is capped at about 40% of the card and ends in …, so the task keeps its room; a row without detail centers its mark on the title
      - listitem: "Right-to-left: lines and buttons follow the card's direction, and each title and detail reads in its own direction"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Insert it in the thread at the first message after since, and keep it there – it marks where the person left off
      - listitem: "Keep detail to one line of what happened: Opened PR #482, Waiting on: Which queue?, Failed: rate limit on Stripe"
      - listitem: When a needs-you item is answered, change its kind to done and its detail to the answer – the row stays where it is
      - listitem: For a full overnight recap with a chart see Agent Recap; this one is the small inline version
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-awc, e.g. --ui-awc-needs, --ui-awc-done, --ui-awc-failed
